title: The action object the loop and every body share
description: Produced by SP-2 (delta drag, pixel-aimed pointer) and extended by SP-3 (the unreal action), consumed by SP-5. Fields are additive: a body that ignores a field it does not know must keep working, because four bodies already implement this contract and only the host body gains the new verbs now.

type.description: unreal is the API channel added by SP-3, advertised through Capabilities so the Brain is offered it only on a body that has it.

x.description: Image-space x, the same frame the Eyes saw.

x2.description: Image-space x of the drop point, when it is a named target.

y2.description: Image-space y of the drop point, when it is a named target.

destination_offset.description: Delta drag: release at (x + dx, y + dy). This is how a drop onto empty graph canvas is expressed, because there is no element there for the Eyes to locate. Mutually exclusive with x2/y2.

method.description: The unreal action's API method name, passed through to the editor unchanged.

params.description: The unreal action's parameters, passed through unchanged. The loop never interprets them; the editor's API owns the meaning.
